name: curtis-ai-porter
description: Port your AI chat history — ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, anything — into Curtis .curt files and Obsidian-ready markdown, and back out to continuation packs, ChatGPT-shape JSON or API JSONL. Local-first: nothing leaves your machine.

scripts.test: npm run build && node esbuild.config.mjs tests && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.smoke: node esbuild.config.mjs tests && node --test dist-test/smoke.test.js dist-test/artifacts.test.js

author: Jordan Newell (Curtis AI)
